import itertools
from pysat import SATSolver
from pysat.formula import CNF

n = 13
edges = []
idx = 0
edge_index = {}
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        edges.append((i, j))
        edge_index[(i, j)] = idx
        idx += 1

# Create CNF
cnf = CNF()

# Variables: 1..78 for each edge (True = blue (1), False = red (0))
# For each 4-set, add clauses
for combo in itertools.combinations(range(n), 4):
    # edges in this 4-set
    e_indices = []
    for i in range(4):
        for j in range(i+1, 4):
            a, b = combo[i], combo[j]
            e_indices.append(edge_index[(a, b)] + 1)  # 1-indexed for pysat
    # At least one blue (positive literal)
    cnf.append(e_indices)
    # At least one red (negative literal)
    cnf.append([-v for v in e_indices])

# Fixed assignments
fixed = {3:1, 6:0, 13:0, 19:0, 27:0, 34:1, 35:0, 43:1, 56:1, 63:0, 65:1, 74:0, 75:0, 76:0, 77:0}
for k, v in fixed.items():
    lit = (k+1) if v == 1 else -(k+1)
    cnf.append([lit])

print("Number of variables:", 78)
print("Number of clauses:", len(cnf.clauses))

# Solve
solver = SATSolver()
solver.append_formula(cnf)
status = solver.solve()
print("Status:", status)
if status:
    model = solver.get_model()
    # model is list of literals; positive = True (blue), negative = False (red)
    solution = [0]*78
    for lit in model:
        if lit > 0:
            solution[lit-1] = 1
        else:
            solution[-lit-1] = 0
    print("Solution:", solution)
    # Verify fixed
    for k,v in fixed.items():
        assert solution[k] == v, f"Mismatch at {k}"
    # Verify no monochromatic K4
    for combo in itertools.combinations(range(n), 4):
        colors = []
        for i in range(4):
            for j in range(i+1, 4):
                a,b = combo[i], combo[j]
                colors.append(solution[edge_index[(a,b)]])
        if all(c==0 for c in colors):
            print("Red K4 found:", combo)
        if all(c==1 for c in colors):
            print("Blue K4 found:", combo)
    print("Verification done.")
else:
    print("UNSAT")
